title: Gaia full CMake build exceeds the queue memory cap at default parallelism
body: The documented cmake --build build-release (default -j32) exceeded the live queue 32170 MB cap at 32899 MB before finishing. Retrying with cmake --build build-release --parallel 1 is required to keep the full Gaia witness within the reservation; the build workflow should derive a safe parallelism from the queue reservation.

title: Gaia queued build wrapper can remain alive after gmake has emitted terminal errors
body: The upstream baseline cmake --build job emitted terminal GCC errors and gmake stopped, but the queue wrapper remained alive with gmake waiting and no active compiler child for about 12 minutes. The exact-PID cleanup was required before another queue job could run; the wrapper should detect payload termination and emit a clear actionable failure.

title: Queued CTest failure diagnostics omit the failing test source location
body: The Debug CTest job failed at src/test/src/test_mt.cpp:2460, but with-test-lock classified the first failure as missing_source_location and required a manual log inspection. The queue should preserve the doctest file:line and test name in its actionable diagnostic so the first failure is directly located.
